description: This file implements logging functionalities for the WPEFramework project, including syslog integration, exception dumping, and system file logging.

methods.name: DetectLoggingOutput
methods.description: Detects whether logging output should go to console or syslog based on environment variable.

methods.name: SysLog
methods.description: Logs messages either to syslog or to stdout depending on configuration.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: Dumps unhandled exception information and call stack to logs.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: Logs system information such as memory info, load average, and process status.
